🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 40s, with deep-set eyes has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the man in his 50s mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" the person in their 20s asks "Tell me you didn't go alone."
